verses.text: Haton heb' yinhtilal winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Moisés tik, ayik ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' t'a jolom witz Sinaí.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón chi': Winhaj Nadab b'ab'el winak, winhaj Abiú, winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar.
Ha heb' chanhwanh tik, ix sik'jiel heb', ix ochkan yopisio heb' sacerdoteal.

Palta a winhaj Nadab yet' winhaj Abiú chi', ix cham heb' winh t'a yichanh Jehová t'a tzinan lum Sinaí, yujto ix yak'och jun k'ak' heb' winh icha ofrenda t'a yichanh Jehová to manh smojok. Mantalaj yuninal heb' ta', yuj chi' haxonhej winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar ix munlaj sacerdoteal t'a yalanh smandar winhaj Aarón haton smam heb'.
Ix lolonxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan icha tik:
Awtej masanil heb' winh winak t'a yinhtilal Leví, yik skolwaj heb' yet' winhaj sacerdote Aarón icha ol yal winh.

Ha heb' chi' ayoch yopisio t'a yichanh winhaj Aarón chi' yet' t'a yichanh chonhab' t'a mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a. Stanhwanpax masanil yamk'ab' yik mantiado chi' heb'. Icha chi' tz'aj yak'ji serwil masanil chonhab' Israel yuj heb' t'a masanil munlajel b'aj ay in kajnub'.
Ik'chajokab'el heb' levita t'a skal heb' eyetchonhab' smasanil yik wach' syak' serwil winhaj Aarón heb' yet' t'a masanil yinhtilal winh.
Anhej t'a yib'anh winh yet' yinhtilal tz'ochkan yopisio yak'an sacerdoteal. Tato ay junok mach manh yinhtilok winh chi' syekoch sb'a t'a jun opisio chi', yowalil schami, xchi t'a winh.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Toxo ix ex in sik'kanel a ex levita ex tik sk'exulok junjun heb' b'ab'el winak unin t'a skal heb' etisraelal, yuj chi' wik eyaji.

Ayik ix wak'ancham masanil heb' b'ab'el winak unin t'a Egipto, ix wak'kan sb'ab'el winak unin heb' etisraelal yik tz'ochkan wikok, icha pax chi' nok' b'ab'el yune' nok' he molb'etzal nok' wik yaji. Ha in Jehová in swala', xchi t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' t'a tzinan lu'um Sinaí, ix yalani:
Ik'k'e wa'an sb'isul heb' etlevitail, icha junjun makkiltakil, masanil heb' winak t'a he kal. Tza chael yich t'a heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, xchi Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yik'cha'anh sb'isul heb' winhaj Moisés chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Leví: Haton winhaj Gersón, winhaj Coat yet' winhaj Merari.
Haxo heb' yuninal winhaj Gersón chi': Haton winhaj Libni yet' winhaj Simei, haton heb' winh tik sb'inajnhej t'a yinhtilal.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Coat: Haton winhaj Amram, winhaj Izhar, winhaj Hebrón yet' winhaj Uziel, haton heb' winh tik sb'inajnhej t'a yinhtilal.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Merari: Haton winhaj Mahli yet' winhaj Musi, haton heb' winh tik sb'inajnhej t'a yinhtilal. Ha heb' winh tik, yajal yaj heb' winh t'a junjun makan yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví.
Ha heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón, cha makan yaj heb', haton heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Libni yet' heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Simei.
Ha sb'isul heb' winak t'a smasanil, ix chajiel yich t'a heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, ay 7 mil 500.
Masanil heb' tik, ha t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, t'a spatik skajnub' Jehová tz'aj scampamento heb'.
Ha pax mach yajal yaj t'a yinhtilalkan winhaj Gersón, haton winhaj Eliasaf yuninal winhaj Lael.
Haton heb' tz'ilan juntzanh smakul yib'anh skajnub' Jehová b'aj sch'ox sb'a yet' k'apak cortina ayoch t'a sti' skajnub' chi',
k'apak scortinail amak' oyanoch t'a spatik skajnub' Jehová yet' b'aj ay altar, k'apak cortina ayoch t'a sti' amak' chi' yet' sch'anhal ayoch t'a spatik syamk'ab'il.
Ha heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Coat, chanh makan yaj heb': Haton heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Amram, heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Izhar, heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Hebrón yet' heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Uziel.
Ha sb'isul masanil heb' winak ix schael yich t'a heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, ay 8 mil 600 heb', haton heb' tz'ilan skajnub' Jehová.
Masanil heb' tik, ha t'a stz'eyel skajnub' Jehová t'a stojolal sur tz'aj scampamento heb'.
Ha yajalil juntzanh heb', haton winhaj Elizafán yuninal winhaj Uziel.
Haton heb' tik tz'ilan te' skaxail trato, te' mexa, sb'akhnub' candil, chab' altar yet' masanil jantak syamk'ab'il sk'anchaj t'a yol skajnub' Jehová yet' pax k'apak cortina ayoch t'a yo'ol.
Ha jun sat yajal yajoch t'a skal heb' levita chi', haton winhaj Eleazar yuninal winhaj sacerdote Aarón, a winh tz'ilan masanil heb' smunlaj t'a skajnub' Jehová.
Ha heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Merari, cha makan yaj heb', haton heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Mahli yet' heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Musi.
Ha sb'isul masanil heb' winak, tz'el yich t'a heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, ay 6 mil 200 heb'.
Ha yajalil heb', haton winhaj Zuriel yuninal winhaj Abihail. Tz'aj scampamento heb' t'a stz'eyel skajnub' Jehová t'a stojolal norte.
Haton heb' tik tz'ilan te' smarcoal, sreglail, yoyal, sb'akhnub'al, masanil syamk'ab'il,
yet' pax yoyal oyanoch t'a spatiktak amak', sb'akhnub'al, yestacail yet' masanil sch'anhal.

Haxo pax t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a yichanhb'at skajnub' Jehová tz'aj scampamento winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal winhaj Aarón chi', haton heb' tz'ak'wi serwil t'a yol skajnub' Jehová chi' yuj swach'ilok heb' israel. Tato ay junok mach sk'och t'a slak'anil kajnub' chi' to manh yopisio'ok yaji, tojolnhej schami.

Ayik ix yik'ancha'anh sb'isul heb' levita winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón t'a stzolal icha ix aj yalan Jehová, a sb'isul heb' winak t'a smasanil, ay 22 mil, tz'el yich t'a heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Ik'cha'anh sb'isul yet' sb'i heb' b'ab'el winak unin t'a skal heb' etchonhab', tz'el yich t'a heb' jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati.

Ha heb' levita tik, wik yaj heb' sk'exulok heb' b'ab'el unin chi'. Hanheja' wikpax tz'ajkan masanil nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' sk'exulok nok' sb'ab'el yune' nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' israel tik. Ha in ton Jehová in swala', xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix ik'jicha'anh sb'isul masanil heb' b'ab'el winak unin t'a skal chonhab' Israel yuj winhaj Moisés chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Masanil heb' winak unin jun ujal sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati, ay 22 mil 273 heb'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Ak'kanoch heb' levita tik sk'exulok heb' b'ab'el winak unin t'a skal chonhab' Israel. Hanheja' pax nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' tz'ochkan sk'exulok nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' yetisraelal, yujto wik yaj heb' levita tik. Ha in ton Jehová in swala'.

Palta ek'al sb'isul heb' b'ab'el unin t'a chonhab' Israel t'a yichanh heb' levita chi', yuj chi' ha t'a junjun heb' 273 b'ab'el unin syak' sobre chi', tza k'an oyeok siclo k'e'en plata, icha jantak yalil k'e'en sk'anchaj t'a in kajnub', haton 20 geras yalil.
Tzak'an juntzanh k'e'en tumin chi' t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal, haton tz'och sk'exulok heb' b'ab'el unin syak' sobre chi', xchi Jehová.
Icha chi' ix aj smolank'e k'e'en tumin winhaj Moisés ix och sk'exulok heb' b'ab'el unin t'a skal chonhab' Israel syak' sobre chi'.
Ix molchaj mil 365 siclo k'e'en plata, icha jantak yalil k'e'en sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an k'e'en winhaj Moisés t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a heb' yuninal, icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
